table.retrieve:
SELECT
	PolicyName=T.Name,
	Code=T.Code,
	QtyLimit=T.QtyLimit,
	DiscPerc=T.DiscPerc,
	ItemFlatDisc=T.ItemFlatDisc,
	ExpiryDate=T.ExpiryDate,
	ICode = I.ICode,
	AliasName = I.CustomICode,
	ItemName = I.Name,
	SalePrice = ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 OR I.PackUnits IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2),
	AvgPrice = I.AvgPrice,
	Profit = ((ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 OR I.PackUnits IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2) - I.AvgPrice) - T.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - T.DiscPerc * 0.01),
	ProfitPerc = (((ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 OR I.PackUnits IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2) - I.AvgPrice) - T.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - T.DiscPerc * 0.01) / CASE WHEN ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 OR I.PackUnits IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2) IS NULL OR ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 OR I.PackUnits IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE ROUND(I.SalePrice / CASE WHEN I.PackUnits = 0 OR I.PackUnits IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE I.PackUnits END, 2) END) * 100
FROM
	Item I,
	(SELECT 
		Name = (SELECT D.Name FROM DiscountPolicy D WHERE D.DiscountPolicyCode=DD.DiscountPolicyCode),
		Code=DD.DiscountPolicyCode,   
		QtyLimit=DD.QtyLimit,   
		DiscPerc=DD.DiscPerc,
		ItemFlatDisc=DD.ItemFlatDisc,
		ExpiryDate=DD.ExpiryDate
	FROM 
		DiscountPolicyDetail DD
	WHERE DD.DiscountPolicyCode = :ai_discountpolicycode) T
WHERE 
	I.DiscountPolicyCode = T.Code
table.sort: policyname A, itemname A, qtylimit A
